info.title: Inventory Management System API Documentation (Version 2)
info.description: API documentation for the Inventory Management System built with Laravel and documented using OpenAPI (Swagger). This documentation provides details about the available endpoints, request/response formats, authentication methods, and other relevant information for developers integrating with the IMS API.

post.summary: Verify two-factor code and receive JWT token
post.description: Second step for users with 2FA enabled. Provide the two_factor_token from /api/login plus either a TOTP code or a recovery_code.

message.example: Two-factor token is invalid or expired.

product.description: Product resource with related UOMs, movements, images and BOM

post.summary: Create an externally purchased product with initial stock movement
post.description: Creates a product and an initial EXTERNAL_PURCHASED / IN / COMPLETED movement. The server enforces `product_type` = EXTERNAL_PURCHASED; do NOT supply `product_type` in the request. `product_status` is automatically set to COMPLETED and cannot be changed. Supply `purchase_unit_price_in_usd` + `exchange_rate_from_usd_to_riel` (totals are derived); supply `selling_unit_price_in_usd` + `selling_exchange_rate_from_usd_to_riel` for selling price. Submitting `raw_materials` is NOT allowed and will be rejected with a validation error.

base_uom_id.description: Base unit id used for storing stock (base_uom_id)

patch.summary: Update the initial EXTERNAL_PURCHASED movement for a product
patch.description: Updates the initial EXTERNAL_PURCHASED stock movement created when the product was first added. The movement is selected automatically; callers should provide the product id only. Updates are blocked if the movement has been used/sold.

post.summary: Create an internally manufactured product with initial stock movement
post.description: Creates a product and an initial INTERNAL_PRODUCED / IN movement. The server enforces `product_type` = INTERNAL_PRODUCED and will ignore any supplied `supplier_id`. Purchase price is automatically set to 0 (produced internally). Supply `raw_materials[]` BOM to record which raw materials are consumed. Raw material stock is validated (FIFO/LIFO) and deducted automatically via PRODUCTION_RECEIPT OUT movements. Supply `selling_unit_price_in_usd` + `selling_exchange_rate_from_usd_to_riel` for selling price.

base_uom_id.description: Base unit id used for storing stock (base_uom_id)

product_status.description: Current product status. Accepted values: DRAFT, WORK_IN_PROGRESS, PARTIALLY_COMPLETED, COMPLETED, BLOCKED

patch.summary: Update the initial INTERNAL_PRODUCED movement for a product
patch.description: Updates the initial INTERNAL_PRODUCED stock movement created when the product was first added. The movement is selected automatically; callers should provide the product id only. Updates are blocked if the movement has been used/sold.

422.description: Validation error or insufficient raw material stock

post.summary: Create a reorder movement for an externally purchased product
post.description: Creates a RE_ORDER / IN product movement. Supply purchase and selling unit prices in USD and the USD->Riel exchange rates. Totals and Riel equivalents are derived by the server.

patch.summary: Update an existing reorder movement for an externally purchased product
patch.description: Update a previously created RE_ORDER / IN movement. Updates are blocked if the movement has been used/sold.

post.summary: Create a reorder movement for an internally manufactured product
post.description: Creates a RE_ORDER / IN product movement for an internally manufactured product. Purchase costs are zero and raw materials (BOM) must be supplied; raw material stock will be validated and deducted.

422.description: Validation error or insufficient raw material stock

patch.summary: Update an existing internal-manufacturing reorder movement
patch.description: Update a previously created RE_ORDER / IN movement for an internally manufactured product. Updates are blocked if the movement has been used/sold. Raw material adjustments are not performed on update.

post.summary: Create a scrap movement for a product
post.description: Creates a SCRAP / OUT movement for a product. Financial fields are set to zero for scrapped stock.

parameters.description: Search by material name / SKU / barcode / related names (depends on implementation)

get.summary: Get a raw material by ID
get.description: Retrieve a single raw material with relations: category, supplier, warehouse, base UOM (base_uom_id), stock movements, images.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the raw material with the given id. The model must use SoftDeletes for restore to work.

patch.summary: Update raw material + its PURCHASE stock movement
patch.description: Updates raw material fields and updates the existing PURCHASE stock movement fields (quantity, unit_price_in_usd, exchange_rate_from_usd_to_riel, note, movement_date). PURCHASE movement type cannot be changed. Supplier is stored on raw_materials.

base_uom_id.description: Base unit id used for storing stock (base_uom_id)

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of soft-deleted raw materials. Useful for restore/review workflows.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of items per page (default 10, max 100)

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Search by material name / SKU / related names

post.summary: Create raw material (with initial PURCHASE stock movement + optional images)
post.description: Creates raw material main data, then automatically creates one RM stock movement (movement_type=PURCHASE, direction=IN, movement_date=now). Supports up to 4 images.

base_uom_id.description: Base unit id used for storing stock (base_uom_id)

production_method.description: Optional; if not provided, defaults to FIFO. Stored on raw_materials for informational purposes but does not affect stock movement logic.

patch.description: Restores a previously soft-deleted raw material. The RawMaterial model must use SoftDeletes.

delete.description: Deletes one or more raw material images. Send an array of image IDs (use a single ID in the array to delete one image at a time). Images are deleted from storage and removed from the rm_images table.

image_ids.description: Array of rm_images IDs to delete (max 4)

404.description: Raw Material not found or some images not found for this raw material

post.summary: Reorder raw material stock (creates RE_ORDER / IN movement)
post.description: Creates a stock movement with movement_type=RE_ORDER and direction=IN. Pricing/valuation is computed from quantity, unit_price_in_usd and exchange_rate_from_usd_to_riel.

patch.description: Updates an existing RE_ORDER stock movement. Only accepts quantity, unit_price_in_usd, exchange_rate_from_usd_to_riel, movement_date, and note. Other currency fields are computed server-side. If the movement is already in use, update is blocked.

errors.example: The reordered material has been used. Data cannot be updated to avoid data inconsistency.

post.summary: Stock adjustment out (creates ADJUSTMENT_OUT / OUT movement)
post.description: Creates a stock movement with movement_type=ADJUSTMENT_OUT and direction=OUT. Pricing fields are forced to 0 (not calculated). Note is required. Fails if deduction quantity is greater than current stock quantity.

items.example: Stock deduction qty must not be greater than current stock quantity.
